normative_precedence.joint_authority: Every v1e file in normative_file_inventory is jointly normative. No listed file silently overrides another.
normative_precedence.historical_only: v1a, v1b, and v1c proposal files are provenance and defect evidence only; v1c consensus is binding repair provenance but no v1c runtime byte has inherited authority.
normative_precedence.contradiction: Any missing inventory entry, unregistered producer or consumer, unregistered object shape or ordering, unmapped condition, multiple mapping, or disagreement among listed v1e bytes is INVALID_PRECONDITION/PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION before dispatch. Implementation and tests may reject but may not choose a preferred reading.
normative_precedence.completeness_test: P1CB01 extracts the v1e paths named by change.json and requires exact set equality with normative_file_inventory and file_contract_matrix, exactly one row per file in each; requires exactly P1CB01 through P1CB10 in acceptance_bindings; expands every producer_consumer_matrix row into directed producer-to-consumer edges and requires endpoint-reciprocal declarations in file_contract_matrix; and rejects omitted or extra files, edges, schemas, orderings, validity routes, ledger mappings, review resources, claim resources, or acceptance bindings.

file_contract_matrix_rule.set_equality: The set of file values below must exactly equal normative_file_inventory.file and the v1e-relative context paths in change.json after adding terminal_claim_state.schema.json: exactly 39 unique files, no omission or extra.
file_contract_matrix_rule.reciprocal_edges: Every direct filename dependency below occurs twice: once in producer.provides_to and once in consumer.consumes_from. Every producer_consumer_matrix semantic-object edge must be among those reciprocal pairs after normalizing prose qualifiers to named files. Each additional reciprocal pair must be justified by object_schema_registry, ordering_registry, validity_registry, ledger_registry, acceptance_bindings, or a jointly normative contract dependency; unidirectional, missing, or unjustified pairs are PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION.
file_contract_matrix_rule.per_file_dimensions: Every row must have nonempty produces_or_governs, ordering_or_none, validity, ledger_or_none, and acceptance_bindings. An empty semantic dimension, duplicate file row, unknown P1CB ID, or missing reciprocal endpoint is PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION.

review_boundary.separation: AGENTS.md operationally requires a fresh-context independent-review invocation and a separate author-side advocate over an identical immutable packet. The packet contains only the pre-review request-plan manifest, never future response/disposition hashes. Later assignments, requests, responses, actor IDs, role labels, freshness declarations, and dispositions bind to that unchanged packet and remain hash-bound SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED workflow records only.
review_boundary.not_proved: No platform-owned issuer/signature/lookup exists. The package does not claim platform attestation, authentication, canonical identity, actual freshness, or cryptographic, ontological, human, model, or reviewer independence.
review_boundary.reviewer_supremacy: An advocate may explain or recommend repair but cannot override REJECT or INVALID; changed bytes require new ratification and new reviews.
review_boundary.packet_requirements: Every packet contains P1CB10, the broad/stage-conditional/resubstitution/review-evidence claim-rejection receipt, the role-declaration manifest, the separate-review request-plan manifest, and applicable ledger/schema artifacts. Terminal packets also bind terminal_claim_state.schema.json evidence. Assignments and dispositions are produced only after packet freeze; the authority token then binds the two completed disposition hashes and grants either the exact successor stage or HUMAN_TERMINAL.
review_boundary.scoped_departure: v1d R10 selected authenticated platform-owned receipts. Because no qualifying external issuer exists, v1e deliberately proposes the weaker evidence boundary rather than fabricating a receipt. Fresh v1e deliberation and exact human ratification must accept or reject this departure before implementation.
